description:
When reality doesn’t look the way he wants, Reo quits his fate as the heir to a deathcare empire to pursue an uncertain streaming career as a “Ptuber”. As he struggles with growing his online persona against a looming deadline for his family-funded living arrangements, he enlists the help of a successful and charismatic Ptuber after an innocent comment he makes turns the two strangers into unwitting subjects of a new trending topic.

Meanwhile, the successful and charismatic Lee is secretly struggling with his own reality as he juggles maintaining his offline persona… and trying to figure out his enigmatic collaboration partner.
______________________________________________________
